\[
I_{\text{out}}(x,y) = \min\,\Bigl\{\, v \;:\; \sum_{(i,j)\,:\,I(x+i,\,y+j) \le v} w_{ij} \;\ge\; \tfrac{1}{2} \sum_{(i,j)} w_{ij} \,\Bigr\}
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(w_{ij}\): Weight of window position (i, j)
- \(v\): A candidate output value

Sort the window values and add up their weights from the smallest value up. The output is the first value at which the running weight reaches half of the total. For whole weights with an odd total, this is the median of the list in which each value is repeated as often as its weight. For an even total it is the lower of the two middle values.
